column1: # Runtime config per battery tag — the "held constant" fields, actually recorded.
# Q50.md has always listed ctx 32768 / KV q8_0 / parallel 1 under "Held constant
# for every row (comparability)". Nothing ever RECORDED or VERIFIED it. The KV
# type then silently flipped to f16 on this box (it is sticky, global, and not an
# `lms load` flag), and rows were compared across two different KV settings
# without anyone knowing. A held-constant nobody measures is not held.
# provenance=measured  -> emitted by probe_runtime_config.sh at run time. Trust it.
# provenance=inferred  -> reconstructed from QUALITY-DOSSIER.md / Q50.md notes plus
#                         corroborating VRAM in SPEED-PROBES.tsv, because nothing
#                         recorded it at the time. Best available reconstruction,
#                         NOT evidence. Do not cite an inferred row as proof.
# bin_ver/bin_mtime: `claudette --version` is identical across dev rebuilds of the
# same release, so the mtime is the actual build fingerprint. The PATH binary has
# not changed since 2026-07-20 12:12:33, which predates every Q50 run — so the
# agent was genuinely constant across the whole campaign.
# cpu_expert_ratio/offload_ratio (added 2026-07-25): the GPU/CPU expert split, the
# same class of hazard as KV — sticky per-model config, not an `lms load` flag, not
# in `lms ps --json`. It moved mid-session on MTP-GPU-4 and shifted A1 from 67s to
# 30s, so VRAM alone was recording it only indirectly. Rows predating the column
# carry `na`; `unset(default)` means LM Studio auto-split for this box's hardware.
# ONLY compare scores across rows whose kv_k/kv_v AND ctx match.
